"Urban planners increasingly advocate for 15-minute cities, where essential services are accessible within a short walk or bicycle ride. Proponents argue this design drastically cuts transportation emissions and fosters resilient local social cohesion. However, implementing this model in historically car-dependent suburban sprawls requires comprehensive zoning overhauls and massive capital investments in public transit corridors."
What is the main implication of this analysis?
